response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with a strong web/backend background, but the profile does not align with this embedded networking security role. Two hard requirements are unmet: native-level Japanese proficiency (only English, Romanian, and basic German listed) and demonstrable C/UNIX embedded systems work — C appears only in a brief 2014–2015 stint at National Instruments and a university thesis. There is no evidence of Linux kernel analysis or source modification, MACsec/802.1X/Captive Portal, L2/L3 switching, switch chip SDKs, or firmware development. Recent experience is TypeScript/Node.js, cloud, and AI tooling, which is largely orthogonal to LAN-switch firmware development.
strengths: 15+ years of software development experience across many domains
Some C/C++ background (LabWindows/CVI at National Instruments) and Linux familiarity
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, and open-source contributions
concerns: No Japanese language ability — a stated hard requirement
No embedded firmware, networking (L2/L3, switching), or security-protocol experience
No Linux kernel investigation or source-code modification experience; C skills are dated

key_factors.factor: Lacks embedded networking and security domain experience
Limited and dated C/UNIX and kernel-level experience
